Sharp-Eyed Sight Disks, but Only a Saw Blade Is Found
Who, what, where, why are flying disks? The year's biggest mystery produced these Sunday photos while reports came from everywhere and everyone that the saucers were everywhere. Top left, a movie camera is fitted to a P-51 fighter plane at Portland, Ore., as Oregon national guard planes are made ready to chase the disks.
—AP Wirephotos and Journal Staff
